title: A page that adapts, and a button that reacts

checks.name: the nav is hidden on a phone
the nav is a flex row from md
#cards is a grid with a gap
#cards has one column on a phone
#cards has two columns from md and four from lg
the button is blue with white text
the button is darker on hover
the button shows an outline with keyboard focus
the body is white, and dark grey in dark mode
Tailwind generated the variants
checks.fail: Tailwind did not generate every class this exercise asks for. A class it does not know is silently left out: check the spelling on the page.

hints: A variant goes in front of the class with a colon: md:flex, hover:bg-blue-700, dark:bg-gray-900.
The nav: class="hidden md:flex". The h1: class="text-2xl md:text-4xl".
#cards: class="grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4". The button: class="bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 focus-visible:outline-2".
